name: ToDo - ロック画面ウィジェット
subtitle: 優先順位とウィジェットでタスク管理
description:
やることを、緊急度と重要度で整理するTodoアプリです。

■ 4つの優先順位で整理
「緊急かつ重要」「重要だが緊急ではない」「緊急だが重要ではない」「緊急でも重要でもない」の4分類で、タスクを見渡せます。期限日時やメモも設定できます。

■ ホーム画面で優先タスクを確認
小・中・大のウィジェットに対応。未完了タスクを、優先順位と期限とともに表示します。

■ ロック画面で今日と次を確認
今日が期限の未完了件数と、次のタスクを表示します。表示する情報はアプリの設定で切り替えられます。

■ 予定の前にリマインダー
期限の10分前・30分前・1時間前を選べます。通知日時を直接指定することもできます。期限を変更した場合は、通知時刻をもう一度選んでください。通知の表示や音はiPhoneの通知設定・集中モードに従います。

■ 自分に合う配色
オフホワイト、ダーク、端末に合わせる配色を選べます。

タスクと設定は端末内に保存します。アカウント登録は不要です。

reviewNotes:
Review information for version 1.0.0, build 6

1. Physical-device screen recording
Pending: a recording captured on a physical iPhone running the latest iOS will be attached/provided before resubmission. It must start with launching the submitted app and demonstrate the normal task, reminder, and widget flows.

2. Purpose and audience
Todo is a personal productivity app for Japanese-speaking general consumers who want to prioritize daily work and personal tasks. It groups tasks by urgency and importance, offers local deadline reminders, and makes pending tasks visible on Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. No organization membership is required.

3. Setup and main features
No account, login credentials, payment, sample file, or server setup is required. The installed app name is Todo. The interface is Japanese.
- Launch Todo, tap "＋ タスクを追加", enter a title and choose urgency/importance. Optionally set a due date/time and memo, then save. The list shows four priority groups.
- Tap a task title to edit it. Tap its circle to complete it. "完了済み" opens completed tasks, which can be restored. Tasks can also be deleted in the editor.
- In the editor, set a future deadline, then select "10分前", "30分前", or "1時間前" under the reminder controls. A custom notification date/time is also supported. Allow notifications when prompted while saving. If the deadline changes, select the relative-time button again to recalculate the reminder. Completing/deleting a task or disabling its reminder cancels the scheduled notification. iOS notification settings and Focus apply.
- Home Screen: use iOS Add Widget, search for Todo, then add a small, medium, or large "Todo / 優先タスク" widget. Create a task in the app first. Tap the widget to open Todo.
- Lock Screen: use iOS Lock Screen customization, select Add Widgets and Todo, then choose "Todo / 今日と次のタスク". Inline, circular, and rectangular layouts are supported. The rectangular layout shows today's pending count and the next task; the circular layout prioritizes the count. "Today" counts incomplete tasks due on the local calendar date. "Next" chooses the nearest deadline, including overdue tasks, or priority order if no deadlines exist.
- In "設定", change appearance and independently enable/disable "今日の未完了タスク数" and "次のタスク". iOS controls widget refresh timing. Task data and preferences persist locally across app restarts.

4. External services/tools
Core functionality runs locally using React Native/Expo, AsyncStorage, Apple WidgetKit/SwiftUI with an App Group, and iOS local notifications. There is no app backend, cloud sync, remote push service, authentication provider, advertising, analytics, payment processor, AI service, or external task-data provider. Support/privacy links open dopa-min.jp in the external browser; they are informational pages and are not required for core features.

5. Regions
Distribution is limited to Japan. There are no region-dependent feature gates or content variations. Dates, notifications and today's task count follow device local time. The UI is Japanese.

6. Accounts, content, payments, regulated services
The app has no account creation/login, social sharing, public user-generated content, paid content, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Task text is private to the device and is not published to other users. The app does not provide a regulated service or distribute protected third-party material.
